finding: Sales use catalog cost_price times quantity; no FIFO layers, moving-average purchase recosting or specific-identification workflow found.
required_action: Implement the approved permitted formula and eligible landed-cost allocation; retain item valuation history.
acceptance_example: Receipts at 100 and 140, partial sale, returns and freight produce the approved valuation and COGS.
implementation_evidence: inventory.py: adoption, receipt, consume, restore_return; inventory valuation UI
remaining_review_or_scope: Accountant/Owner approves formula for interchangeable goods; FIFO and specific identification are not implemented.

finding: Quantity adjustments exist; no separate lower-of-cost/NRV valuation allowance and reversal tracking found.
required_action: Add item-level NRV assessment, valuation adjustments without quantity loss, reversal caps and disclosures.
acceptance_example: Cost 100 / NRV 80 writes down 20; later recovery cannot exceed original cost.
implementation_status: Implemented NRV valuation and capped reversal
remaining_review_or_scope: Approve a dedicated allowance account and item-level selling/completion cost evidence.

finding: Supplier bills accept expenses only and explicitly defer goods receipts. Generic bill entry is not a complete inventory acquisition workflow.
required_action: Add/review goods receipts, supplier bill matching, costs, rebates and recoverable/nonrecoverable tax treatment.
acceptance_example: Buying unsold stock records inventory, not an immediate ordinary expense.
implementation_status: Implemented matched receipt and supplier bill
implementation_evidence: inventory.py: GoodsReceipt and receipt; existing supplier payment allocation
remaining_review_or_scope: Confirm line allocations, rebates and tax recoverability; no automatic tax-rate/legal determination.

finding: Loan receipt 100 and repayment 40 appear as one net 60 financing line; ordinary gross classes are not separated.
required_action: Preserve gross receipt/payment classes unless a documented IAS 7 netting exception applies.
acceptance_example: Ordinary borrowing shows proceeds 100 and repayments 40 separately; net cash change remains 60.
implementation_evidence: reports.py: cash_flow; real PostgreSQL loan acceptance
remaining_review_or_scope: Review exceptional netting arrangements separately; this release uses ordinary gross presentation.

finding: Interest paid 10 appears only within Net profit -10, with no separate interest-paid line in sections rendered by the UI.
required_action: Separate interest/dividend cash disclosures, preventing duplication, under a documented applicable-period policy.
acceptance_example: Interest accrual versus settlement, capitalized interest and dividends are disclosed in correct periods/categories.
implementation_status: Implemented explicit classifications and cash settlement disclosures
implementation_evidence: cash_rules.py; reports.py direct and assigned supplier/client settlements
remaining_review_or_scope: Existing custom/legacy interest, dividend and tax accounts require explicit dated classification approval.

standard: IAS 7 cash definition / IFRIC demand-deposit decision
finding: Every restricted flow-section mapping is forced into investing. Restriction alone does not establish investing classification or exclude a demand deposit from cash.
required_action: Separate cash eligibility, restrictions and transaction classification; require reviewed facts.
acceptance_example: Restricted qualifying demand deposit remains cash when appropriate; non-cash movement is not invented.
implementation_status: Implemented reviewed cash eligibility and restrictions
remaining_review_or_scope: Restricted balances block the cash report until reviewed; restrictions alone do not imply investing.

finding: No full components/policy note, financing-liability movement note or supplier-finance disclosure workflow found.
required_action: Add cash-equivalent policy, balance-sheet reconciliation and applicable financing/supplier-finance notes.
acceptance_example: Financing opening/closing balances reconcile cash and non-cash movements separately.
implementation_status: Implemented components and financing rollforward plus reviewed notes
implementation_evidence: reports.py; cash-flow UI/exports; close.py IAS7-04 note
remaining_review_or_scope: Accountant supplies cash-equivalent policy, balance-sheet differences and supplier-finance terms/disclosures.

finding: Detailed income/position statements and optional comparatives now exist; OCI, changes in equity and complete material notes are not supplied.
required_action: Add the complete applicable statement/note package and annual comparative controls.
acceptance_example: Equity rollforward agrees to position; notes and comparative periods reconcile.
implementation_status: Implemented ledger-supported close package and comparative coverage gates
implementation_evidence: close.py: statements, OCI, equity, notes, comparative cash flow; close workspace/PDF
remaining_review_or_scope: Pre-cutover or missing comparative periods require a separately reviewed external package; this release blocks approval instead of inventing comparatives.

finding: Standard loan account is NON_CURRENT_LIABILITY; classification follows account type, not contractual maturity/covenants.
required_action: Split/reclassify current/non-current amounts based on reporting-date facts and applicable rights.
acceptance_example: Current portions and covenant cases are classified correctly.
implementation_status: Implemented dated maturity reclassification in close package
implementation_evidence: close.py: Maturity and liability section reclassification
remaining_review_or_scope: Owner/Admin and accountant review contractual rights/covenants for current and comparative reporting dates; base ledger remains unchanged.

finding: Issuing an invoice triggers revenue and product fulfillment; no explicit control/performance-obligation assessment, progress or contract-liability workflow found.
required_action: Restrict supported transactions to documented satisfied obligations or implement recognition schedules/deposits/returns.
acceptance_example: Advance invoice is not revenue before performance; goods delivery and over-time services have appropriate timing.
implementation_status: Implemented completed-obligation scope and confirmation evidence
implementation_evidence: workflows.py: invoice_create; invoice-service.ts; invoice confirmation UI
remaining_review_or_scope: Legacy clients retain completed-sale contract defaults with audit flag; accountant must validate historical performance. Advances/over-time recognition are refused.

evidence: chart template:1100,2500; reports.py; reviewed accounting modules
finding: Receivable/payable controls exist; no dedicated ECL/provision-matrix, effective-interest or risk-note workflow found.
required_action: Add/review allowances, approved risk assumptions, measurement and financial-instrument disclosures.
acceptance_example: Gross receivable and ECL allowance reconcile; assumptions and risk exposure are disclosed.
implementation_evidence: close.py: Schedule, gross movement/control-account ties, FIN-01 notes
remaining_review_or_scope: Accountant prepares ECL assumptions, effective-interest calculations, instrument measurement and risk disclosures; not an automated ECL engine.

finding: Custom fixed-asset accounts and manual journals exist, but those do not establish asset registers, depreciation/componentization, amortization or impairment assessment.
required_action: Add or formally integrate reviewer-controlled asset, useful-life, impairment and disposal schedules.
acceptance_example: Asset and accumulated-charge rollforwards reconcile to ledger and disclosures.
implementation_evidence: close.py: ASSET-01 schedules with exact opening/movement/closing ledger ties
remaining_review_or_scope: Accountant maintains component lives, residual values, impairment/disposals and posts reviewed journals; no automatic depreciation engine.

finding: Rent expense exists; right-of-use/liability measurement and schedules were not found. Not all leases qualify for simple expensing.
required_action: Assess exemptions and implement/reconcile relevant lease measurement and notes.
acceptance_example: Applicable lease recognizes asset/liability and subsequent depreciation/interest separately.
implementation_evidence: close.py: LEASE-01 ROU/liability schedule ties and notes
remaining_review_or_scope: Accountant assesses exemptions, discount rates, ROU/liability measurement and posts reviewed journals; no automatic lease calculator.

finding: VAT invoice restrictions do not address current/deferred income-tax accounting.
required_action: Add approved current/deferred income-tax calculations, balances and disclosures where applicable.
acceptance_example: Tax expense/payable and temporary differences reconcile; VAT is assessed separately.
implementation_status: Implemented approved external tax calculation integration
implementation_evidence: close.py: TAX-01 expense/balance schedules and disclosure review
remaining_review_or_scope: Accountant supplies current/deferred tax calculations and temporary differences and posts reviewed journals; VAT remains separately scoped.

finding: Operational payroll and wages accounts do not alone prove accrued benefits, pension obligations or related financial-statement presentation.
required_action: Reconcile payroll/benefit accruals and employer obligations to ledger; evaluate plan-specific requirements.
acceptance_example: Unpaid benefits and employer contributions accrue in correct periods.
implementation_evidence: close.py: PEOPLE-01 expense/liability schedule ties and notes
remaining_review_or_scope: Accountant evaluates benefits/pensions and reconciles employer obligations; no actuarial calculation is fabricated.

finding: Backend supports single-currency NGN; FX rates, retranslation and translation workflows are not implemented.
required_action: Confirm functional currency and block unsupported transactions or implement FX/translation controls.
acceptance_example: Foreign monetary items and exchange differences use appropriate reporting-date treatment.
implementation_evidence: existing session.py currency gate; close.py mandatory functional-currency note
remaining_review_or_scope: Confirm NGN functional currency and absence of unsupported FX; multicurrency/translation remain unsupported.

finding: Reversals/audit exist, but period policy changes/restatements, subsequent events, related-party and provision/contingency notes are not evidenced as a complete workflow.
required_action: Add or integrate a documented close, judgment and note checklist with accountant approval.
acceptance_example: Prior-period errors, adjusting events, related parties and provisions receive appropriate treatment/disclosure.
implementation_status: Implemented immutable policy/close review and independent approval
implementation_evidence: close.py: all-item applicability notes, schedules, fingerprints and approval
remaining_review_or_scope: Accountant prepares substantive policies/events/related-party/provision notes and necessary journals; attestation text is not audit assurance.

finding: Current cash flow starts from net profit; reporting policy is not versioned for IFRS 18 and new subtotals/categories.
required_action: Plan effective-date/early-adoption handling and transition comparatives; do not apply 2027 requirements blindly to 2026.
acceptance_example: Affected periods use required subtotals/start point and updated interest/dividend classification.
implementation_status: Implemented transition plan and effective-period approval gate
remaining_review_or_scope: Full IFRS 18 presentation engine and transition comparatives remain future implementation; approval is blocked for affected periods.
